source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: At the opening of Declare Battle Formations, join the Ogryn Bodyguard to one **COMMAND SQUAD** from your army that has no other **LOYAL PROTECTOR**. Add the model to the squad and increase its Starting Strength. If joining is impossible, leave the model out of the battle and count it as destroyed. It uses 3 places when embarked in a **[TRANSPORT](vsdata:core-rule/transports)** and cannot be the **WARLORD**. It also cannot take an Enhancement.

detail.trigger: start of Declare Battle Formations step
